failedGraders: judge:A Sales Reports page was just added under packages/app/react/src/routes/(app)/reports/. Verify ALL of: (a) UI-COMPOSITION — the route index.tsx is a thin shell: the URL contract (validateSearch with the recorte field typed against the SDK ChartType values and defaulted, dates defaulted to a last-30-days window) plus layout composition only — no SDK hook calls, no business JSX in the route; a Section component under -components/ owns the single useGetChart query; static UI (page header, recorte selector) stays visible while data loads, with an inline NON-exported skeleton in the data-dependent area only, and the data area follows skeleton -> empty -> content (an empty state where a member can be genuinely empty, e.g. income buckets / region rows). (b) DATA-OWNERSHIP — the section reads recorte/dates via the route's search hook and tenancyScope via a useTenancyStore selector; exactly ONE component calls useGetChart; the route never fetches and passes data down; recorte changes write through router navigation (a search updater or Link), never component state; variant components receive the ALREADY-FETCHED response (or their member of it) by prop and never re-fetch; no useState and no new Zustand store anywhere under the new directory. (c) DISC-UNION + CENTRALIZE-MAPS — each of the five kinds renders through its own variant sub-component, selected via ONE module-level dispatch map keyed by the SDK ChartType (exhaustive — a new kind must break tsc), not via a switch or an if/else-if chain across kinds inline in a single component; no all-optional flattened row type that merges the five members; no hand-rolled parallel union re-declaring the SDK kinds; no casts (as any / as never / as unknown) to force the map-lookup correlation. (d) LOCALE-MONEY + ENUM-REPR — every monetary value renders through the useMoney() formatter (the SignedMoney object handed over as-is; no amountCents/100 hand-math, no toFixed, no direct formatMoney import from @/lib/format inside components); income bucket date labels format with the active locale obtained from useLocale() — never a hardcoded 'pt-BR'/'en-US' or a date-fns locale object; the recorte option labels come from the i18n enums.ChartType.* catalog with entries present in BOTH src/locales/pt.json and en.json; weekday/day-part segment labels are translated via i18n keys, not hardcoded strings. Scope notes — judge the idiom, not the variable name: a variant sub-component receiving the fetched response or its narrowed member as a prop is the EXPECTED CMP-P18/CMP-P05 shape — do not fail it as prop-drilling. Because TypeScript cannot correlate a map lookup with a union-typed prop, BOTH cast-free typings pass: a map of uniform-signature views that each take the full response and guard their own kind with an early return (if (data.kind !== 'weekday') return null), OR Extract-typed variant props with the correlation resolved type-safely — do not fail the single-kind guard as an "if chain"; what fails is one component branching across MULTIPLE kinds inline, or flattening. tenancyScope living in the app-global Zustand store (useTenancyStore) instead of the URL is the house canon — do not fail it. A const-asserted ordering array for fixed segment keys (MONDAY..SUNDAY, MORNING..NIGHT, hour sorting) resolves ORDER, not labels — fine. Hardcoding frequency: 'DAILY' in the query params is per the brief — fine. The dispatch map spelling may be Record<ChartType, ...>, satisfies Record<...>, or a mapped type keyed by ChartType — all fine. The pre-existing dashboard chart (src/routes/(app)/dashboard/-components/RevenueChartSection/) carries known deviations and is OUT of scope — judge only the new files under src/routes/(app)/reports/ plus src/locales/pt.json and en.json.
